cases.summary: --inject {"graphics":{"bytes":"over_cap"}}: serve runs with the QA seam --qa-graphics-sequence-max-bytes 4096 on a qa-fixture root, so crossing the cap does not depend on PTY throughput; the program writes text, a Kitty m=1 chunk of 4097 payload bytes plus its m=0 final chunk, then text; the viewer receives exactly one graphics_dropped record (too_large, kitty, limit 4096, sequence_bytes 4097, output_offset 13) between the two texts and none of the series' bytes, and terminal.screen shows the text joined on one row: the grid is what the VT drew from every raw byte. The advertised 8 MiB default is asserted on the stream config by unit tests.
